text:
incident-bot: Pager triggered — SEV: high. Runtime queue depth > 95% in prod-usw2 (decoder shards). 429 spike and p95 latency increase. Link: https://incidents.redwood.example/INC-40321 :rotating_light:

sam-oncall: Acked. I'm paged, joining. Any quick customer impact notes?

priya: Looking at metrics now — decoder queue length and inflight per-model both jumped at 15:03:12 UTC. KV cache miss rate up 3x. Some long-tail requests from embeddings-async feature.

ben-runtime: Proposed live mitigations (low-risk first):
- lower runtime max_inflight for prod-usw2 from 20 -> 10 for non-critical routes
- enable soft-shedding for sequences > 1024 tokens
- reduce default request timeout from 60s -> 25s for best-effort routes
- disable embeddings-async feature flag (it spawns extra fanout causing tail latencies)

sam-oncall: Good. Priya/Ben — can you run the commands? I will coordinate and notify support. No deploys unless needed. :thumbsup:

ben-runtime: Running CLI now:
```bash
# runtime control CLI
rctl runtime adjust --pool prod-usw2 --route 
  "route:priority!=critical" --max-inflight 10 --enable-shedding soft
```
Applying...

ben-runtime: Done. Shedding enabled and max_inflight updated on 6/8 shards. Rolling to remaining shards.

priya: Toggling timeout and feature flag:
```bash
rctl runtime set-timeout --env prod-usw2 --route "best-effort" --timeout 25s
feature-toggle disable embeddings-async --env prod-usw2 --reason "live mitigation: queueing spike"
```
Feature flag disabled. Timeouts updated.

sam-oncall: Noted. Kai (support) — please post a short customer advisory for affected tenants and escalate any P0s.

kai-support: Posted status to status.redwood.example and opened CS ticket queue. Notifying top 5 customers via DM. So far one customer reported increased 504s (Customer-42).

priya: Early impact: within 40s of changes p95 token-latency dropped from ~650ms to ~210ms, and 429 rate down 78%. Queue depth trending down. CPU on busiest shards from 96% -> 70%.

sam-oncall: Great. Keep observing for 15m. No rollback unless metrics worsen. I'm going to page next-oncall for handoff if this stays stable.

ben-runtime: Note: shedding will convert long-running requests to 503s for non-critical routes — we preferred 503 over tail latencies causing retries. Added a tag to docs: docs.runtime/mitigations-2026-03-17.

priya: Adding a quick postmortem checklist: capture spike window, identify request patterns (model, route, token lengths), check KV cache pressure, evaluate whether we need to permanently tune max_inflight or increase pool capacity.

sam-oncall: Handing off in 12m to next-oncall. Please keep thread updated. I'll attach graphs in incident page. :white_check_mark:

next-oncall: Taking handoff 15:25 UTC. I'll keep watch and coordinate capacity bump if we see re-emergence.

incident-bot: Incident updated — mitigations applied. Current status: mitigated (monitoring).
